sanity.title: Sanity
sanity.maxHint: Maximum SAN (99 − Unnatural). Raising Unnatural lowers it by the same amount.
sanity.breakingPointHint: When SAN falls to or below this, the character gains a disorder and the Breaking Point resets to SAN − Will.
sanity.unnaturalHint: Unnatural knowledge. Max SAN is 99 − Unnatural; raising it lowers max SAN (and current SAN if needed).
sanity.adaptationHint: Each SAN loss from violence or helplessness checks a box. With all three checked the character is adapted and loses no more SAN from it.
sanity.breakingPointHelp: SAN is at or below the Breaking Point: record a disorder.

enabled.name: Agency: SAN and Breaking Points
enabled.hint: Delta Green-style sanity: SAN panel on actor sheets, SAN loss in the Fright Check dialog, /san chat command and [SAN 0/1d4] OtFs.

roll.name: Agency: SAN roll
roll.hint: What decides between the success and failure side of a SAN loss such as 0/1d6.
roll.fright: Fright Check (3d6 vs Fright Check, same modifiers)

multiplier.name: Agency: starting SAN multiplier
multiplier.hint: Starting SAN = Will × this (Delta Green: POW × 5). Breaking Point starts at SAN − Will.

bondStart.name: Agency: starting Bond score
bondStart.hint: Score of a new Bond. 0 = the character's Will.

dialog.hintFright: Success on the Fright Check costs the left value, failure the right. Leave blank for no SAN loss.
dialog.hintPercentile: A separate d100 ≤ SAN roll picks the left (success) or right (failure) value. Leave blank for no SAN loss.
dialog.title: SAN check: {name}

card.title: SAN check: {name}
card.ruleOf14: (Fright Check cannot be greater than 13. See The Rule of 14, B360.)
card.becameAdapted: Now adapted to {category}. Every Bond loses 1:
card.temporaryInsanity: Lost {lost} SAN from one roll: temporary insanity (GM: flee, struggle or submit).
card.breakingPoint: SAN fell to or below the Breaking Point ({bp}): record a disorder.
card.addUnnaturalHint: GM: Delta Green raises Unnatural by the SAN lost the first time a character meets an unnatural phenomenon.

note.projected: {name} projects onto {bond}: rolled {roll}, {refund} SAN restored, Bond {before} → {after}.
note.bpReverted: SAN is back above the old Breaking Point: Breaking Point restored to {bp} (no disorder).
note.insanityAverted: Loss reduced to {remaining}: no temporary insanity.

disorderPrompt.title: Disorder: {name}
disorderPrompt.text: Record the disorder gained at the Breaking Point.

project.title: Project onto a Bond: {name}
project.text: Roll 1d4: the SAN loss is reduced by the roll and the chosen Bond loses the roll.

unnaturalPrompt.title: Raise Unnatural
unnaturalPrompt.text: Raise {name}'s Unnatural by {amount} ({before} → {after})? Max SAN becomes {max}.

chat.usage:
/san <success/failure> [violence|helplessness|unnatural] [description]
Rolls a SAN check for the selected character, e.g. /san 0/1d6 violence or /san 1/1d4+1 unnatural Sees the thing.

errors.disabled: SAN is turned off in the system settings.
errors.badNotation: Not a SAN loss: '{text}'. Use success/failure, e.g. 0/1d6 or 1/1d4+1.
errors.noBonds: This character has no Bond left to project onto.
errors.notLatest: Only the character's most recent SAN loss can be projected onto a Bond.
errors.alreadyProjected: This SAN loss has already been projected onto a Bond.
errors.nothing-to-project: There is no SAN loss to project.
errors.already-projected: This SAN loss has already been projected onto a Bond.
